rics.description: Exports of Goods, Balance of Payments Basis, % month on month, Standardized, Chg P/P
rics.meaning: China Exports: Goods, Balance of Payments Basis, % month on month, Standardized, Chg P/P. Detailed export series by product/category from China Customs.
rics.how_to_use: Customs publishes detailed monthly bilateral and product-level export data. China is the world's largest goods exporter. Key categories: electronics, machinery, autos (rapidly growing — EVs), chemicals, textiles, steel.

rics.description: Exports of Goods, Balance of Payments Basis, % year on year, Standardized, Chg Y/Y
rics.meaning: China Exports: Goods, Balance of Payments Basis, % year on year, Standardized, Chg Y/Y. Detailed export series by product/category from China Customs.
rics.how_to_use: Customs publishes detailed monthly bilateral and product-level export data. China is the world's largest goods exporter. Key categories: electronics, machinery, autos (rapidly growing — EVs), chemicals, textiles, steel.

rics.description: Exports of Goods, Balance of Payments Basis, Standardized
rics.meaning: Goods Exports on BoP basis (standardized) — quarterly merchandise exports level.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-check against monthly customs (aCNCEXPB/A). BoP basis differs slightly due to coverage and timing methodology.

rics.description: Imports of Goods, Balance of Payments Basis, % month on month, Standardized, Chg P/P
rics.meaning: China Imports: Goods, Balance of Payments Basis, % month on month, Standardized, Chg P/P. Detailed import series by product/category from China Customs.
rics.how_to_use: Customs publishes detailed monthly bilateral and product-level import data. Major Chinese imports: integrated circuits, crude oil, iron ore, soybeans, copper, machinery. Track monthly YoY changes for cycle signal.

rics.description: Imports of Goods, Balance of Payments Basis, % year on year, Standardized, Chg Y/Y
rics.meaning: China Imports: Goods, Balance of Payments Basis, % year on year, Standardized, Chg Y/Y. Detailed import series by product/category from China Customs.

rics.description: Visible Trade Balance, Balance of Payments Basis, Standardized
rics.meaning: Visible Trade Balance (BoP basis), standardized — quarterly goods trade balance. Largest CA component.
rics.how_to_use: Annual surplus ~$700B (world's largest goods surplus). Cross-check against monthly customs data (aCNCEXPB/A minus aCNCIMPB/A).

rics.description: Visible Trade Balance, Balance of Payments Basis, month on month, Standardized, Absolute change
rics.meaning: Visible Trade Balance, QoQ absolute change — quarter-over-quarter momentum.
rics.how_to_use: Track quarterly direction. Cross-check against the YoY change (aCNCBOPYA) for cleaner trend.

rics.description: Visible Trade Balance, Balance of Payments Basis, year on year, Standardized, Absolute change
rics.meaning: Visible Trade Balance, YoY absolute change — year-over-year goods balance change.
rics.how_to_use: Smooths quarterly noise. Track for goods-trade cycle direction; pair with monthly customs data.

rics.description: Outward Investment, Net FDI
rics.meaning: China International Investment Position: Outward Investment, Net FDI. SAFE quarterly statistics on China's external assets/liabilities.
rics.how_to_use: China is a net external creditor (net IIP positive ~$3 trillion). Reserve assets ($3.2T) dominate external assets; FDI liabilities (~$3T) dominate liabilities. Net direct investment position has been deteriorating as outbound FDI slows and inbound FDI weakens.

rics.description: Current Account Balance as a percentage of GDP, Standardized
rics.meaning: Current Account Balance as % of GDP, standardized — the headline external-balance ratio. China's CA/GDP fell from ~10% (2007) to ~2% post-2014 reflecting growth rebalancing.
rics.how_to_use: China CA/GDP currently ~2% — moderate surplus. Sustained moves toward deficit (as in late 2010s) would indicate weakening external position. The yuan's structural appreciation drivers depend on this.

rics.description: Current Account Balance as a percentage of GDP, quarter on quarter, Standardized
rics.meaning: Current Account % of GDP, QoQ change — sequential momentum of CA-to-GDP ratio.
rics.how_to_use: Track quarterly inflection points. Use the level series (aCNCCURQ/A) for cross-country comparison.

rics.description: Current Account Balance as a percentage of GDP, year on year, Standardized
rics.meaning: Current Account % of GDP, YoY change — annual change in CA-to-GDP ratio.
rics.how_to_use: Smooths quarterly variability. Use for CA/GDP trend; China CA/GDP swings 1-2pp through commodity cycles.

rics.description: Capital Account, Balance, Annual, State Administration of Foreign Exchange, China
rics.meaning: Capital Account Balance, Annual — annual aggregate of capital-account flows.
rics.how_to_use: Annual frequency aggregate. Capital account is small relative to current and financial accounts in China.

rics.description: Capital Account, Balance, Quarterly, State Administration of Foreign Exchange, China
rics.meaning: Capital Account Balance — quarterly capital-account balance (small in China; dominated by transfers).
rics.how_to_use: Tiny relative to current and financial accounts. Mostly captures bilateral aid, debt forgiveness, intangible asset transfers. Not market-moving.

rics.description: Capital and Financial Account, Balance, Quarterly, State Administration of Foreign Exchange, China
rics.meaning: Capital and Financial Account Balance — combined capital + financial accounts. Mirror of current account balance.
rics.how_to_use: Should equal -CA balance (with errors and omissions). Useful for total-financing-side cross-check.

rics.description: Financial Account, Balance
rics.meaning: Financial Account, Balance — net flows of FDI + portfolio investment + other investment + reserves. Mirror of current account.
rics.how_to_use: Decompose: FDI flows (typically inflows but recent declines), portfolio (volatile, Stock Connect / Bond Connect dependent), other investment (loans, trade credits). 2024 saw weak FDI inflows — major macro concern.

rics.description: Financial Account, Balance, Non-reserve
rics.meaning: Financial Account, Non-Reserve Balance — financial account excluding reserves changes. The 'private capital flow' measure.
rics.how_to_use: Cleaner private-capital signal than total financial account. Sustained negative non-reserve balances mean private capital is leaving — pressure for reserves to fill the gap.

rics.description: Financial Account, Direct Investment, Balance
rics.meaning: China International Investment Position: Financial Account, Direct Investment, Balance. SAFE quarterly statistics on China's external assets/liabilities.
rics.how_to_use: China is a net external creditor (net IIP positive ~$3 trillion). Reserve assets ($3.2T) dominate external assets; FDI liabilities (~$3T) dominate liabilities. Net direct investment position has been deteriorating as outbound FDI slows and inbound FDI weakens.

rics.description: Financial Account, Other Investment, Balance
rics.meaning: Financial Account: Other Investment Balance — non-FDI, non-portfolio cross-border flows (loans, trade credits, currency/deposits).
rics.how_to_use: Often the residual that absorbs unmeasured capital flows. Persistent large net-outflow balances indicate capital flight pressure.

rics.description: Financial Account, Portfolio Investment, Balance
rics.meaning: Financial Account: Portfolio Investment Balance — net flows of equity + bond portfolio investment. Highly volatile; Stock Connect / Bond Connect channels matter.
rics.how_to_use: Sensitive to global risk sentiment and US-China rate spread. 2022-23 saw heavy outflows; 2024+ stabilizing. Watch alongside Bond Connect monthly statistics.

rics.description: International Service Trade, Construction services, credit
rics.meaning: China International Service Trade: International Service Trade, Construction services, credit. Services exports/imports — travel, transport, insurance, financial services, IP royalties.
rics.how_to_use: China runs a structural services-trade deficit (~$200B/year), driven by tourism (Chinese outbound > inbound) and IP royalty payments. Tourism deficit narrowed during COVID (2020-22) but is reverting as travel resumes.

rics.description: Current Account Balance, Standardized
rics.meaning: Current Account Balance, level — quarterly absolute current account. Publishes ~3 months after quarter-end by SAFE.
rics.how_to_use: China runs persistent CA surpluses (~$300-400B/year recently). Surplus driven by goods trade (~$700B annually) offset by services deficit (~$200B, mostly tourism + IP royalties) and primary income deficit (~$50-100B).

rics.how_to_use: China is a net external creditor (net IIP positive ~$3 trillion). Reserve assets ($3.2T) dominate external assets; FDI liabilities (~$3T) dominate liabilities. Net direct investment position has been deteriorating as outbound FDI slows and inbound FDI weakens.
